summary: Backend-only test of the trimmed career_detail endpoint (GET /api/careers/{career_id}) per review request. Full flow executed: register -> PUT /api/profile -> POST /api/recommendations/generate -> poll /api/recommendations -> fresh (uncached) career_detail call -> repeat (cached) call. Also quick regression check on /api/roadmap/custom and /api/roadmap/tasks/{id}/resources.
critical_code_review_comments: career_detail (server.py ~line 670-696) trim verified correct: profile fetch and 'Profil użytkownika' injection removed, new isolation line 'To jest odrębne, samodzielne zapytanie...' present and working - response for one career_id did not leak context from other careers/profile.

Caching logic (db.career_details, keyed by user_id+career_id) unchanged and verified: fresh call 2.27s (real LLM round trip via FAST_MODEL), cached repeat call 0.07s with byte-identical detail payload.
No regressions in find_career/404 handling, job_links(), or roadmap/custom and task resources endpoints.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_iter26_career_detail_trimmed.py (new pytest file; fixed one bug while writing it - endpoint is PUT /api/profile, not POST as assumed from the review request wording)
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST_iter26_* throwaway user via /api/auth/register with a profile, recommendations, and a custom roadmap ('Analityk danych'); not cleaned up (low-risk test data, read-mostly verification).
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iter26_career_detail_trimmed.py validates: (1) register -> PUT /api/profile (note: PUT not POST) -> generate+poll recommendations to get a real career_id; (2) GET /api/careers/{career_id} fresh call returns 200 with career/detail/job_links, detail has all 7 expected keys as non-empty values, content verified Polish via diacritics heuristic; (3) repeat call returns identical cached detail in <5s (actual: 0.07s vs 2.27s fresh); (4) career_levels sanity-printed and manually inspected - for 'asystentka działu księgowości' it returned a realistic accounting-specific ladder (Asystentka -> Specjalista ds. księgowości -> Księgowa -> Starszy księgowy -> Główny księgowy), confirming the isolation prompt produces profession-specific (not generic junior/mid/senior) levels; (5) no 500/502 or exceptions in backend logs; (6) /api/roadmap/custom and /api/roadmap/tasks/{id}/resources regression-checked, both 200.
rca_of_issue: No bugs found. The trimmed career_detail prompt works as intended: removing the profile injection did not break output quality/structure, and the added isolation instruction appears effective (no cross-career bleed observed in this test, though this is a qualitative/single-sample observation, not exhaustively proven across many careers).
